prompt: Name a sport or discipline at the Summer Olympics

answers.name: Swimming
answers.fact: Michael Phelps won 23 Olympic golds, the most of any athlete.

answers.name: Athletics
answers.fact: The first modern Olympic marathon, in 1896, was won by Greek water carrier Spyridon Louis.

answers.name: Gymnastics
answers.fact: Nadia Comăneci's perfect 10 in 1976 showed as 1.00: the scoreboard couldn't display it.

answers.name: Football
answers.fact: Olympic men's teams are mostly under-23s, with three older players allowed.

answers.name: Basketball
answers.fact: James Naismith invented it in 1891 using peach baskets.

answers.name: Tennis
answers.fact: Dropped from the Olympics after 1924 and only brought back in 1988.

answers.name: Boxing
answers.fact: Muhammad Ali won Olympic gold in 1960 as Cassius Clay.

answers.name: Breaking
answers.fact: Debuted at Paris 2024, and it's already off the programme for LA 2028.

answers.name: Modern pentathlon
answers.fact: Fencing, swimming, riding, running and shooting: designed to test a 19th-century cavalry officer.

answers.name: Dressage
answers.fact: 'Horse ballet', where men and women compete against each other.

answers.name: Volleyball
answers.fact: Invented in 1895 as a gentler alternative to basketball.

answers.name: Beach volleyball
answers.fact: At Paris 2024 it was played right in front of the Eiffel Tower.

answers.name: Diving
answers.fact: From the 10 m platform, divers hit the water at around 50 km/h.

answers.name: Road cycling
answers.fact: The Paris 2024 road race climbed up through Montmartre.

answers.name: Rowing
answers.fact: Steve Redgrave won gold at five Olympics in a row.

answers.name: Sailing
answers.fact: Ben Ainslie won medals at five Olympics in a row.

answers.name: Fencing
answers.fact: One of only five sports at every modern Olympics since 1896.

answers.name: Judo
answers.fact: Japan's first Olympic sport, debuting in Tokyo in 1964.

answers.name: Taekwondo
answers.fact: Sensors in the vest and headgear score the kicks electronically.

answers.name: Wrestling
answers.fact: Part of the ancient Olympics as far back as 708 BC.

answers.name: Weightlifting
answers.fact: Lifters do two lifts: the snatch, and the clean and jerk.

answers.name: Archery
answers.fact: Olympic archers shoot at a target 70 metres away.

answers.name: Badminton
answers.fact: Smashed shuttlecocks can leave the racquet at over 400 km/h.

answers.name: Table tennis
answers.fact: China has won the large majority of Olympic table tennis golds.

answers.name: Golf
answers.fact: Came back in 2016 after a 112-year absence.

answers.name: Rugby sevens
answers.fact: Fiji's first-ever Olympic medal was rugby sevens gold in 2016.

answers.name: Hockey
answers.fact: India has won eight Olympic hockey golds.

answers.name: Handball
answers.fact: Huge in Europe. The ball is small enough to grip in one hand.

answers.name: Triathlon
answers.fact: The Paris 2024 swim leg was held in the Seine.

answers.name: Skateboarding
answers.fact: At its Tokyo 2020 debut, three of the medallists were just 13.

answers.name: Surfing
answers.fact: Paris 2024's surfing was held in Tahiti, about 15,000 km from Paris.

answers.name: Sport climbing
answers.fact: Speed climbers scale a 15 m wall in under five seconds.

answers.name: Shooting
answers.fact: Turkey's Yusuf Dikeç went viral in 2024, winning silver with a hand in his pocket.

answers.name: Water polo
answers.fact: Players aren't allowed to touch the bottom of the pool.

answers.name: Canoe sprint
answers.fact: Hungary is famously dominant in Olympic canoe sprint.

answers.name: Equestrian
answers.fact: The only Olympic sport where humans and animals compete as a team.

answers.name: Show jumping
answers.fact: Horses clear fences up to about 1.65 m high.

answers.name: BMX racing
answers.fact: Riders start from the top of an 8 m high ramp.

answers.name: Mountain biking
answers.fact: Joined the Olympics in 1996.

answers.name: Track cycling
answers.fact: Keirin races start behind a motorbike pacer called a derny.

answers.name: Trampoline
answers.fact: Athletes soar up to around 8 metres above the bed.

answers.name: Rhythmic gymnastics
answers.fact: Routines use a hoop, ball, clubs or ribbon.

answers.name: Artistic swimming
answers.fact: Men could compete in the team event for the first time at Paris 2024.

answers.name: 3x3 basketball
answers.fact: Half court, one hoop: first to 21 or the higher score after 10 minutes.

answers.name: Canoe slalom
answers.fact: Paddlers race through hanging gates on artificial white water.

answers.name: Eventing
answers.fact: The equestrian triathlon: dressage, cross-country and jumping.

answers.name: Marathon swimming
answers.fact: A 10 km race in open water. At Paris 2024 it was in the Seine.

answers.name: BMX freestyle
answers.fact: Riders throw tricks around a park course, judged a bit like skateboarding.

answers.name: Windsurfing
answers.fact: Olympic windsurfers now fly above the water on hydrofoils.

answers.name: Kitefoiling
answers.fact: Made its Olympic debut at Paris 2024, sailed off Marseille.

answers.name: Kayak cross
answers.fact: Four paddlers race at once, and each has to roll their kayak right over mid-course.

answers.name: Greco-Roman wrestling
answers.fact: No holds below the waist: it's all upper body.
